purpose: FD-001 through FD-006 — complete Founder decision package

FD-001.title: foundation_comm Site — Consolidate or Retain
FD-001.decision: Retain sites/foundation_comm as standalone communication site, OR consolidate content into sites/foundation_div and retire foundation_comm
FD-001.current_state: Active standalone site, no Team/Group connection, last active September 2025
FD-001.operational_impact: Links to foundation_comm must be updated if consolidated
FD-001.consequence_of_deferral: Standalone governance exception continues — no operational harm
FD-001.approval_phrase_consolidate: APPROVE FD-001 — CONSOLIDATE foundation_comm into foundation_div and retire
FD-001.approval_phrase_retain: APPROVE FD-001 — RETAIN foundation_comm as standalone

FD-002.title: Enterprise Canon Location
FD-002.decision: Confirm ImplementationHQ/Architecture/00_CANON as the authoritative enterprise canon; publishing copy becomes reference
FD-002.current_state: Two copies — ImplementationHQ (internal wiki) and publishing (rendered output)
alternatives: Designate publishing as authoritative — not recommended (rendering artifact, not source)
FD-002.consequence_of_deferral: Dual-canon ambiguity continues — no operational harm
FD-002.approval_phrase: APPROVE FD-002 — ImplementationHQ/Architecture/00_CANON is the authoritative enterprise canon

FD-003.title: Projects Site Dev Artifact Cleanup
FD-003.decision: Archive and remove dev build artifacts from sites/projects SharePoint
affected_objects: Dev build artifacts in sites/projects (not the site itself)
FD-003.current_state: Build outputs, compiled binaries, CI logs in SharePoint alongside project docs
FD-003.recommendation: ARCHIVE/REMOVE — ZIP first, then remove from SharePoint; GitHub is authoritative
alternatives: RETAIN in SharePoint — not recommended; creates dual-source confusion
FD-003.operational_impact: Dev artifact content no longer in SharePoint; ZIP archive preserved
FD-003.consequence_of_deferral: Dev artifact sprawl continues — no operational harm
FD-003.approval_phrase: APPROVE FD-003 — archive and remove dev build artifacts from sites/projects

FD-004a.title: Sales Team
FD-004a.decision: Archive Sales Team (if inactive) or retain
FD-004a.current_state: Activity unclear — 90-day channel activity audit pending Wave 1/2
FD-004a.recommendation: ARCHIVE after pricing sheet migration if no active channels confirmed
alternatives: RETAIN if active Sales collaboration ongoing
FD-004a.operational_impact: Sales Team archived; pricing sheets migrated first
FD-004a.approval_phrase_archive: APPROVE FD-004a — ARCHIVE Sales Team after pricing sheet migration

FD-004b.title: Voicemail Team
FD-004b.decision: Retain Voicemail Team (until routing dependency confirmed) or archive
affected_objects: Teams Phone routing policies that may reference this Team
FD-004b.current_state: Suspected Teams Phone routing dependency — not yet confirmed or decoupled
alternatives: ARCHIVE if routing confirmed safe — requires routing audit first
FD-004b.operational_impact: Voice routing disruption risk if archived prematurely
FD-004b.approval_phrase_retain: APPROVE FD-004b — RETAIN Voicemail Team pending routing confirmation
FD-004b.approval_phrase_archive: APPROVE FD-004b — ARCHIVE Voicemail Team (use only after routing audit)

FD-005.title: Seven Shared Mailboxes — Classification Required
FD-005.decision: Classify each of 7 shared mailboxes: KEEP-CORE, KEEP-ALIAS, CONSOLIDATE, or RETIRE
FD-005.current_state: 9 of 16 mailboxes already confirmed KEEP (logging@, info@, notifications@, no-reply@, legal@, preneeds@, royalties@, submissions@, tech@). These 7 require explicit Founder classification.

accounting_at.recommendation: KEEP-CORE — 1617 items, active billing/finance identity, multiple critical aliases

grants_at.recommendation: KEEP-CORE — 794 items, active grants administration, revenue-critical

media_at.recommendation: KEEP-ALIAS — public-facing media/PR identity; overlaps with publishing workflow

volunteers_at.recommendation: KEEP-ALIAS — foundation volunteer intake; low volume but Foundation-facing

contacts_at.recommendation: CONSOLIDATE into info@ — 6 items, no forwarding, overlapping purpose with info@

FD-005.operational_impact: RETIRE/CONSOLIDATE: export history first; update external routing and documentation
FD-005.consequence_of_deferral: Shared mailbox sprawl continues — no operational harm
FD-005.approval_phrase: APPROVE FD-005 — accounting@ KEEP-CORE, board@ KEEP-CORE, donations@ KEEP-CORE, grants@ KEEP-CORE, media@ KEEP-ALIAS, volunteers@ KEEP-ALIAS, contacts@ CONSOLIDATE into info@

FD-006.title: Projects Team
FD-006.decision: Archive Projects Team or retain for active collaboration
FD-006.current_state: Projects Team connected to sites/projects. GitHub may be authoritative for all project work.
FD-006.recommendation: ARCHIVE if GitHub confirmed authoritative and no active channel collaboration in 90 days
alternatives: RETAIN if active channel collaboration ongoing
FD-006.operational_impact: Sites/projects becomes read-only when Team archived; must complete Wave 6 Step 2 first
FD-006.consequence_of_deferral: Potentially redundant Team persists alongside GitHub
